title: citrus × taitensis
intro: Citrus × taitensis, commonly known as Kanbō or also called Kanuka, is a hybrid of the lemon (Citrus limon) and the kumquat (Fortunella spp.). This plant is prized for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Citrus × taitensis are attributed to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Citrus × taitensis include flavonoids, limonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
